title: Silver bars bought at Node Alpha for 420 cr or less, sold into the Obsidian Well's bid at Arneb at 480 or more: a trade test beyond the border
note: 2026-11-21 19:59 UTC (Mercury, orders.log ENT-056 block MERCURY: trade beyond our borders). Node Alpha asks silver bar 414 x 50 (book of 19:36 UTC), the first such ask in our books; The Obsidian Well, a player station at Arneb (16 jumps, lawless), bids 501 x 44,527 (book of 19:52 UTC), the bid it showed on 2026-11-17 (table market_hour). About 83 cr a unit before the station's market fee, 50 units, about 4,150 cr a load against about 30 jumps of fuel. No pirate on record in any system of the road (data/intel/sightings.jsonl, scripts/map.py route node_alpha arneb). A test: one ship, one pilot (max_pilots 1), an empty hold out of home; the buy and the sale carry price limits; what the bid leaves is stored at Arneb. Whether Node Alpha's ask comes back is the second question: two runs at a loss rest the route.
